summary: The Garden Court: five terraced garden valleys under a High Gardener, whose fruit and seeds go to every Sunhot fair and whose voice is heard at Noon.

high_gardener.name: The High Gardener
high_gardener.desc: Yanthe was chosen by the valley households for her care of the land, not for wealth or war. She still prunes her own roses at dawn.

eternal_garden.name: The Eternal Garden
eternal_garden.desc: The gardens of Poyang bloom in turn, so that at no season is a valley bare. Visitors say it is the only realm where a person can walk from spring into summer without leaving the path.

flower_markets.name: The Flower Markets
flower_markets.desc: Cut flowers, dried herbs and seed-packets are sold from stalls that fill the market streets at dawn. Poyang's seeds are bought for gardens in realms it has never visited.

healers_herbs_spirit.name: Healers' Herbs
healers_herbs_spirit.desc: Poyang's physic-gardens grow herbs for every ill, and the apothecaries pack them in labelled boxes. Sunhot healers write to Poyang before they write to anyone else.

quiet_mediators.name: The Quiet Mediators
quiet_mediators.desc: When the Sunhot realms quarrel, a Poyang gardener appears with a basket of fruit and a question. By the time the basket is empty, the quarrel is usually over.

a_garden_for_the_council.title: A Garden for the Council
a_garden_for_the_council.desc: The gardeners offer to plant a garden at the Noon Council's hall, so that the Speakers may talk among flowers. The High Gardener asks whose colours the beds should wear, and the other realms are curious to know.

options.name: Let every realm bring a seed

pilgrims_on_the_sea_of_gods.title: Pilgrims on the Sea of Gods
pilgrims_on_the_sea_of_gods.desc: White sails carry pilgrims along the coast for the summer feasts. The harbour keeper of [ROOT.GetName] asks whether they are to be given moorings and a feast-day, or left to sail on.

focuses.name: The Garden Court
focuses.desc: Poyang is five garden valleys, terraced and watered from the hills, whose fruit and flowers are sold at every Sunhot fair. The Noon Council calls it the garden, and listens to it on matters of peace.

focuses.name: The High Gardener
focuses.desc: The valley households choose their High Gardener for her care of the land. Yanthe tends her own beds, and sends seeds as gifts to every realm that writes to her.

focuses.name: The Gardeners' Council
focuses.desc: The gardeners of the five valleys meet at the turn of each season, each with a basket of what they have grown. They argue about rain, and agree about everything else.

focuses.name: The Five Valleys
focuses.desc: Garden paths link the five valleys, edged with low hedges and shaded by fruit trees. A traveller on them is never more than a hundred paces from water.

focuses.name: Seeds for Every Realm
focuses.desc: Poyang sends a packet of seeds to every Sunhot court at the turn of spring, each wrapped in a leaf and labelled in the Gardener's own hand. The gifts are remembered long after the flowers have faded.

focuses.name: The Eternal Garden
focuses.desc: Beds are planted so that something blooms in every season, and the valleys are never quite bare. Poyang's gardeners say they are not working for the year but for the century.

focuses.name: Terraces of Poyang
focuses.desc: Stone-wall terraces climb the valley sides, each faced with local stone and planted with fruit trees. The masons who built them are honoured at the harvest feast.

focuses.name: Water From the Hills
focuses.desc: Springs in the hills are caught in stone cisterns and sent down the terraces by a web of channels. The water-wardens keep the stops and the sluices, and know every drop by name.

focuses.name: The Flower Markets
focuses.desc: Dawn markets fill the streets of the garden towns with cut flowers, dried herbs and seed-packets. Poyang's colours are sold in realms it has never visited.

focuses.name: Granaries of Poyang
focuses.desc: Dry stone granaries stand on every terrace, built to keep fruit, grain and seed through the long winter. They are full by midautumn, and never quite empty by spring.

focuses.name: Healers' Herbs
focuses.desc: Physic-gardens grow herbs for every ill, and apothecaries pack them in labelled boxes. Sunhot healers write to Poyang before they write to anyone else.

focuses.name: The Richest Gardens
focuses.desc: Poyang's gardens have never been so full, nor its coffers. The Gardener puts half the surplus into new beds, and the rest into the treasury.

focuses.name: Poyang's Voice at Noon
focuses.desc: When the Council sits, the High Gardener speaks late and briefly. The Speakers have learned that what she says is usually what they will end by agreeing.

focuses.name: Support the Chair
focuses.desc: Poyang's gardener sends a basket of fruit and a loyal note to the Lands of Light's chair. The Radiant Speaker keeps the note and eats the fruit.

focuses.name: A Garden for the Council
focuses.desc: The gardeners offer to plant a garden at the Noon Council's hall, so that the Speakers may talk among flowers. The beds are laid out in a single afternoon.

focuses.name: The Quiet Mediators
focuses.desc: When the Sunhot realms quarrel, a gardener appears with a basket of fruit and a patient question. By the time the basket is empty, the quarrel is usually over.
